scientific_integrity: The general argument is analytical; finite SciPy numerical consistency tests validate normalizations and convergence signs only; classical Bessel integral-table priority remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed nonnegative integer Bessel modes and q down to 4 from above; the raw fourth moments diverge, and no global sharp stability or growing-index uniformity is claimed.
title: Exact critical fourth-moment gaps in circular Fourier extension
